name: iOS App Development with Swift and SwiftUI
certifications: App Development with Swift Certified User (Apple and Certiport)
Apple Developer Program enrolment for App Store distribution

beginner.summary: For developers and freshers building their first iPhone apps. Covers Xcode and the simulator, Swift for iOS, optionals, structs, classes and protocols, SwiftUI views, layout, state and data flow, lists and navigation, forms, Swift concurrency, URLSession and Codable, SwiftData, images, the Observation framework and MVVM, permissions and device features, notifications, accessibility, Swift Testing, debugging with Instruments, UIKit interoperability and TestFlight and App Store distribution.
prerequisites: Knows programming basics in any language
Comfortable with variables, functions and loops
A Mac that can run the current Xcode
outcomes: Build iPhone apps in Swift with SwiftUI
Structure apps with observable models, async/await, SwiftData and networking
Use device features, notifications and accessibility well
Test, debug and distribute apps through TestFlight and the App Store

days.topic: iOS Development Overview and Xcode Setup
subtopics: The iOS platform and app ecosystem
Swift and SwiftUI as the modern stack
Installing Xcode and the iOS SDK
The simulator and running on a device
Apple developer accounts and provisioning in brief
days.lab_task: Install Xcode, create a SwiftUI project, run it in the simulator and on an iPhone, change the UI with live previews and find a planted crash in the debugger.
days.deliverable: First running app in a Git repository
checks: App installs and runs on an iPhone
Crash cause found from the debugger output
objectives: Explain how iOS apps are built
Run and debug a first app

days.topic: Swift Essentials for iOS Developers
subtopics: Swift style used in iOS code
days.lab_task: Write Swift functions for a habit tracker: streak counts, date formatting, input checks with switch and extensions for display text, with unit tests.
checks: Habit rules expressed with switch and patterns

days.topic: Swift Optionals, Structs, Classes and Protocols in App Code
days.lab_task: Model habits, check-ins and reminders with structs, enums and protocols, handle missing values safely and group check-ins by week with collection methods.
checks: No force unwraps in the model
Enum with associated values covers habit states
Weekly totals correct for sample data

days.topic: SwiftUI Views and Layout
subtopics: Text, Image, Button and other basic views
days.lab_task: Build the habit list row, summary card and add-habit screen layouts with stacks and modifiers, and preview them on two device sizes in light and dark mode.
checks: Previews show two sizes in light and dark mode
Row view reused with different data

days.topic: State and Data Flow in SwiftUI
subtopics: Passing data down and events up
days.lab_task: Add state to the add-habit form with @State and bindings, share a habit store with @Observable and the environment, and show live progress with derived values.
checks: Child control updates the parent's state
Two screens show the same habit data

days.topic: Lists, Grids and Navigation
days.lab_task: Show habits in a sectioned list with swipe to delete, categories in a grid, navigate to details with a NavigationStack, add a sheet for new habits and a tab bar.
days.deliverable: Navigable app with lists and tabs
checks: Habit removed with an undo option
Deep link opens the right habit detail
New habit sheet opens and saves

days.topic: Forms, Input and Validation in SwiftUI
subtopics: Disabling actions until input is valid
days.lab_task: Build a validated habit form with text, pickers, toggles and dates, manage keyboard focus, show inline errors and enable saving only when the input is valid.
checks: Inline errors shown and save disabled
Return key moves focus to the next field

days.topic: Swift Concurrency: async/await and Tasks
subtopics: Why the main thread must stay free
Running work in parallel with async let
days.lab_task: Load data with async functions, run two requests in parallel with async let, update the UI on the main actor, cancel work when views disappear and handle errors.
checks: Two requests finish in the time of the slower one
Work stops when the view disappears
Error state shown instead of a crash

days.topic: Networking with URLSession and Codable
subtopics: Custom coding keys and date strategies
Testing networking with protocols and mocks
days.lab_task: Sync habits with a REST API using URLSession and Codable, handle dates and errors, build an API client behind a protocol and test it with a mock.
checks: App shows habits returned by the API
Friendly messages for server and network errors
API client tests pass without a network

days.topic: Persisting Data with SwiftData
days.lab_task: Store habits and check-ins with SwiftData, query them with sorting and filtering, add a relationship and a schema migration, and use sample data in previews.
checks: Habits remain after relaunching the app
Sorted and filtered lists update automatically

days.topic: Images, Assets and AsyncImage
days.lab_task: Add an app icon and SF Symbols, load remote habit images with placeholders, let users pick photos with PhotosPicker and check memory use with large images.
checks: Photo chosen and shown on the habit
Placeholder shown while remote images load
Memory stays stable while scrolling images

days.topic: App Architecture with the Observation Framework and MVVM
subtopics: When to keep logic in views
days.lab_task: Move screen logic into observable view models backed by services, inject fake services for previews and tests, and organise the project by feature.
checks: View model tests pass with fake services
Previews run with fake data and no network
Each feature has its views, models and services together

days.topic: Permissions, Camera, Photos and Location
days.lab_task: Capture photos for check-ins, tag habits with location, write clear usage descriptions, ask in context, handle denial gracefully and support approximate location.
checks: App explains and keeps working without the feature

days.topic: Local and Push Notifications
days.lab_task: Schedule daily habit reminders with actions, open the right screen from a tap, register for push and send a test push to the simulator.
checks: Daily reminder appears at the set time

days.topic: Accessibility in SwiftUI
days.lab_task: Audit the app with VoiceOver and Accessibility Inspector, add labels and traits, support the largest Dynamic Type sizes and fix contrast and motion issues.
checks: Screens work at the largest text size

days.topic: Testing with Swift Testing and XCTest
subtopics: Running tests in Xcode and from the command line
days.lab_task: Write Swift Testing tests for models and view models with parameterised cases, async tests for networking, a UI test for adding a habit and a coverage report.
checks: Model and view model tests pass
Coverage report generated for app logic

days.topic: Debugging and Instruments
days.lab_task: Find and fix four planted bugs: a layout bug with the view debugger, a retain cycle with the memory graph, a slow screen with Time Profiler and a main thread violation.
checks: Memory graph shows the cycle gone
Time Profiler shows the hot path removed

days.topic: UIKit Interoperability
subtopics: Hosting SwiftUI in UIKit with UIHostingController
days.lab_task: Wrap a UIKit map or text view in SwiftUI with a coordinator, host a SwiftUI screen inside a UIKit navigation flow and plan a gradual migration of one old screen.
days.deliverable: Interop examples and a migration plan
checks: UIKit view works inside SwiftUI with delegate events
SwiftUI screen shown inside UIKit navigation

days.topic: Distributing with TestFlight and the App Store
days.lab_task: Archive a signed build, upload it to App Store Connect, invite testers through TestFlight, fill in the privacy details and prepare a submission checklist.
checks: Build processed in App Store Connect
Privacy answers match what the app collects

days.topic: Beginner Capstone: Habit Tracker App
days.lab_task: Complete the habit tracker with SwiftUI screens, navigation, observable models, SwiftData storage, API sync, photos, reminders, accessibility, tests and a TestFlight build, then demo it.
days.deliverable: Repository, TestFlight build and demo recording
checks: Add, check in, sync and remind flows work end to end
Testers install and use the app
objectives: Combine the beginner topics in one app

intermediate.summary: For iOS developers who have shipped an app. Covers architecture choices including MVVM, coordinators and The Composable Architecture, advanced SwiftUI layout and animation, Swift concurrency with actors and Sendable, offline-first SwiftData sync, networking and token refresh, Sign in with Apple, passkeys and Keychain, APNs push and extensions, background tasks, widgets, Live Activities and App Intents, MapKit, AVFoundation, Swift packages, inclusive design, app security, UI and snapshot tests, Xcode Cloud or Fastlane, performance and StoreKit 2.
prerequisites: Has built and released an iOS app with Swift and SwiftUI
Comfortable with async/await, SwiftData and networking
outcomes: Add authentication, push, widgets, media and payments
Make apps inclusive, secure and fast
Test and deliver apps through CI/CD with monitoring

days.topic: App Architecture: MVVM, Coordinators and The Composable Architecture
subtopics: The Composable Architecture: state, actions and reducers
days.lab_task: Build the same feature with MVVM plus a coordinator and with The Composable Architecture, test both and recommend one for a team of six.
checks: Feature behaviour tested in both architectures
Coordinator drives navigation without views knowing destinations
Recommendation based on team, testing and complexity

days.topic: Advanced SwiftUI: Custom Layouts, Animations and Transitions
subtopics: GeometryReader and when to avoid it
days.lab_task: Build a custom flow layout, a matched geometry transition from list to detail, a keyframe celebration animation and reusable button styles, and check frame rates.
checks: Tags wrap correctly at every width
Card expands smoothly into the detail view

days.topic: Swift Concurrency in Depth: Actors, Sendable and Structured Concurrency
days.lab_task: Move a shared cache into an actor, load images with a task group, bridge a delegate API with AsyncStream and fix every warning under strict concurrency checking.
checks: Cache has no data races under parallel access
Images load in parallel with cancellation
Module builds with no concurrency warnings

days.topic: Offline-First Apps with SwiftData and Sync
subtopics: Local data as the source of truth
CloudKit sync compared with a custom back end
days.lab_task: Make the app fully usable offline with SwiftData, queue offline changes, sync with a back end in the background, resolve conflicts and show sync status.
checks: All features work in airplane mode
Offline edits reach the server when online
Conflicting edit resolved by the agreed rule

days.topic: Networking Layers, Authentication and Token Refresh
days.lab_task: Build a networking layer with typed endpoints, automatic token refresh that serialises concurrent refreshes, retries for safe requests and offline detection.
checks: App shows offline state when the network drops

days.topic: Sign in with Apple, Passkeys and Keychain
subtopics: Face ID and Touch ID with LocalAuthentication
days.lab_task: Add Sign in with Apple and passkey sign-in, an OAuth flow for a company identity provider, Keychain token storage, Face ID unlock and account deletion.
checks: Passkey sign-in works without a password
Tokens stored in the Keychain, not in user defaults
Account and data deleted from the app
objectives: Add modern sign-in to iOS apps

days.topic: Push Notifications with APNs and Notification Extensions
days.lab_task: Send pushes through APNs with a token key, enrich them with images in a service extension, add a custom content extension and debug a delivery problem.
checks: Push arrives with an attached image

days.topic: Background Tasks and Background Downloads
days.lab_task: Refresh data with a background app refresh task, upload photos with a background URLSession that survives app termination and test both with Xcode tools.
checks: Data refreshed while the app is suspended
Upload completes after the app is closed
Background task triggered from the debugger

days.topic: Widgets, Live Activities and App Intents
subtopics: Live Activities and the Dynamic Island
App Intents for Shortcuts and Siri
days.lab_task: Add a configurable progress widget with interactive check-ins, a Live Activity for an active habit session and App Intents for Shortcuts.
checks: Session shows in the Dynamic Island and lock screen
objectives: Expose app actions with App Intents

days.topic: Maps, Location and MapKit
days.lab_task: Show nearby gyms on a map with custom markers, search places, draw a route, monitor arrival at a gym and test with simulated locations.

days.topic: Media: Video Playback, Background Audio and Recording
subtopics: Now Playing info and remote controls
days.lab_task: Build a workout video player with HLS streaming, Picture in Picture, background audio with lock screen controls and voice note recording.
checks: HLS video plays and adapts quality
Playback controlled from the lock screen
Voice note recorded and played back

days.topic: Modularisation with Swift Packages
days.lab_task: Split the app into feature and core Swift packages with clear access control, keep previews and tests per package and measure build time changes.
checks: Only public APIs used across packages

days.topic: Inclusive Design: VoiceOver, Dynamic Type and Localisation
days.lab_task: Localise the app into English, Hindi and Arabic with string catalogs and plurals, support right-to-left layout, add VoiceOver custom actions and test with pseudolanguages.
checks: All text shown in the selected language
VoiceOver users act on rows without extra taps

days.topic: App Security: Data Protection, ATS and Integrity
days.lab_task: Set data protection classes, restrict Keychain items to the device and biometrics, enforce ATS, remove secrets from the binary and scan the app with MobSF.
checks: Files unreadable while the device is locked

days.topic: UI Testing and Snapshot Testing
subtopics: Testing in several sizes and languages
days.lab_task: Write UI tests for the main flows with launch arguments for test data, add snapshot tests for key views in two sizes and two languages and configure a test plan.
checks: Main flows pass in the simulator
Snapshot test fails on a layout change
Test plan runs unit, UI and snapshot tests together

days.topic: CI/CD with Xcode Cloud or Fastlane
subtopics: Code signing in CI with match or cloud signing
days.lab_task: Build a pipeline that tests on each pull request, signs builds without manual steps, increments build numbers and uploads to TestFlight with release notes.
checks: Tests run on every pull request
Build signed in CI without local certificates

days.topic: Performance: Instruments, Memory and Launch Time
days.lab_task: Measure launch time and scrolling, defer launch work, fix a leak and an expensive list cell, collect MetricKit data and record the gains.
checks: Launch time lower after deferring work
Leak gone in the memory graph

days.topic: In-App Purchases and Subscriptions with StoreKit 2
days.lab_task: Add a premium subscription with StoreKit 2, verify transactions, unlock features by status, restore purchases and test renewals with a StoreKit configuration file.
checks: Purchases restored on a fresh install
Renewal and expiry handled in StoreKit testing

days.topic: Analytics, Crash Reporting and Feature Flags
days.lab_task: Add privacy-respecting analytics for key flows, crash reporting with non-fatal errors, a remote feature flag and an A/B test, and confirm tracking rules are respected.
checks: Crash appears with a symbolicated stack trace
Remote flag turns a feature on without a release
No tracking without the required permission

days.topic: Intermediate Capstone: Subscription Fitness App
days.lab_task: Build a fitness app with a chosen architecture, offline sync, passkey sign-in, push, widgets and a Live Activity, media, subscriptions, localisation, tests, CI/CD and crash reporting, then present it.
days.deliverable: Repository, TestFlight build, reports and presentation
checks: Workouts, widgets and subscriptions work end to end
Tests, accessibility and performance reports meet targets
objectives: Combine the intermediate topics in one app

advanced.summary: For senior iOS engineers and mobile leads. Covers large-scale architecture, Swift package modularisation and build times, shared code strategies with Kotlin Multiplatform, SwiftUI internals, rendering, memory and energy performance, App Attest and Secure Enclave, design systems, testing strategy, release engineering, on-device AI with Core ML and Apple's Foundation Models, visionOS, watchOS and iPadOS, privacy manifests, real-time features, observability, UIKit and Objective-C migration, Swift 6 adoption, App Review at scale, server-driven UI and production troubleshooting.
prerequisites: Several years building production iOS apps
Strong Swift, SwiftUI and concurrency skills
Has released apps to large audiences
outcomes: Architect and scale large iOS codebases and teams
Engineer performance, security and privacy for large audiences
Adopt on-device AI and new Apple platforms
Lead releases, migrations and production troubleshooting

days.topic: Large-Scale iOS Architecture
days.lab_task: Design the package and ownership structure of a large banking app for six teams, enforce dependency rules, plan cross-feature navigation and record the decisions.
checks: Build fails on a forbidden package dependency
Every package has an owning team

days.topic: Swift Package Modularisation and Build Times at Scale
days.lab_task: Profile a slow build with the build timeline, split a heavy package, reduce macro cost, add CI caching and track build times on a dashboard.
checks: Incremental build faster after the split

days.topic: Kotlin Multiplatform and Shared Code Strategies for iOS Teams
subtopics: When to share code with Android
Kotlin Multiplatform from the iOS side
Build and dependency integration in Xcode
days.lab_task: Integrate a shared Kotlin Multiplatform module for business rules into the iOS app, call it from Swift with async support and assess the effect on the iOS team.
checks: Swift calls shared rules with natural async APIs
Build, debugging and team impact recorded

days.topic: SwiftUI Internals: Identity, Lifetime and Dependencies
days.lab_task: Explain identity bugs that reset state, trace body evaluations with the SwiftUI instrument, fix excessive updates in a dashboard and record the rules learned.
checks: State no longer resets when the list changes
Body evaluations drop on the dashboard
Rules for identity and dependencies written

days.topic: Advanced Performance: Rendering, Memory and Energy
days.lab_task: Profile hitches, memory and energy on an older iPhone, fix image decoding and rendering costs, avoid jetsam terminations and add performance tests to CI.
checks: Hitch rate drops on the main screen
No memory terminations in the stress test
CI fails when a performance test regresses

days.topic: Security Hardening: App Attest, DeviceCheck and Secure Enclave
days.lab_task: Threat model the app, attest the app on the server with App Attest, sign requests with Secure Enclave keys and run a penetration test.
checks: Server rejects requests without valid attestation
Signing keys never leave the Secure Enclave
objectives: Use App Attest and Secure Enclave

days.topic: Design Systems for iOS Teams
days.lab_task: Build a SwiftUI design system package with tokens, five components, two brand themes, a catalog app and snapshot tests, and migrate one feature to it.
days.deliverable: Design system package and catalog app
checks: Snapshot tests cover every component state
Feature uses only design system components

days.topic: Testing Strategy for Large iOS Codebases
subtopics: Unit, integration, UI and snapshot balance
Contract tests with the back end
days.lab_task: Assess a large app's tests, rebalance by risk, add back-end contract tests, shard UI tests across simulators and cut CI time.
checks: Back-end change breaks a contract test
UI test time reduced with sharding

days.topic: Release Engineering: Phased Releases, Feature Flags and Rollbacks
subtopics: Phased releases on the App Store
days.lab_task: Run a release train with a phased release, pause it on a crash spike, disable a faulty feature with a kill switch and add an update prompt for old versions.
checks: Phased release paused when crashes rise
Faulty feature disabled without a release
Old versions shown an update prompt

days.topic: On-Device AI with Core ML, Vision and Apple Intelligence Models
subtopics: Converting and running custom models with Core ML
Apple's Foundation Models framework on supported devices
Guided generation and tool calling on device
days.lab_task: Add on-device text recognition with Vision, a custom Core ML classifier, an on-device summary with the Foundation Models framework where supported and a cloud fallback, and compare results.
checks: Core ML classifier labels sample images
Cloud path used on unsupported devices
objectives: Add on-device AI to iOS apps

days.topic: visionOS, watchOS and iPadOS Experiences
subtopics: Data sync between iPhone and watch
days.lab_task: Add an iPad layout with multitasking support, a watchOS companion with a complication and a visionOS window for the app's dashboard, sharing models and logic.
checks: Dashboard window works in the visionOS simulator

days.topic: Privacy Manifests, Tracking Transparency and Compliance
subtopics: Privacy manifests and required reason APIs
Preparing for App Review privacy checks
days.lab_task: Generate the privacy report, add missing privacy manifest entries, audit SDKs, update privacy labels and handle tracking consent correctly.
checks: Privacy report covers app and SDKs

days.topic: Real-Time Features: WebSockets and Live Updates on iOS
subtopics: Combining push, sockets and Live Activities
days.lab_task: Add live order tracking with WebSockets, reconnect with backoff, update a Live Activity through push when the app is in the background and measure battery cost.
checks: Order position updates in real time
Battery cost of live tracking measured

days.topic: Observability for iOS Apps
subtopics: What to measure in iOS apps
days.lab_task: Instrument key journeys, collect MetricKit hang and termination diagnostics, compare two releases and set alerts for crash and hang spikes.
checks: Alert fires on a hang spike

days.topic: Migrating UIKit and Objective-C Code to SwiftUI and Swift
subtopics: Replacing delegates and notifications with async APIs
days.lab_task: Migrate two UIKit screens to SwiftUI, convert an Objective-C class to Swift, replace a delegate API with async and move one Core Data model to SwiftData.
checks: Migrated and legacy screens work together
Swift version passes the original tests

days.topic: Adopting Swift 6 Strict Concurrency Across a Codebase
days.lab_task: Move three modules to Swift 6 language mode, fix Sendable and isolation errors, wrap a non-Sendable dependency and track the remaining work.
checks: Three modules build with no concurrency errors
Global mutable state moved into actors or made safe
Remaining modules ranked by effort and risk

days.topic: App Store Review, Policies and Compliance at Scale
subtopics: App Review guidelines that commonly cause rejections
Regional rules such as alternative distribution in the EU
days.lab_task: Review the app against the guidelines, fix three likely rejection causes, prepare review notes and a demo account, and simulate a rejection response.
checks: Review notes and demo account ready
Clear response drafted for a simulated rejection

days.topic: Server-Driven UI and BFF APIs for iOS Apps
subtopics: What iOS apps need from back ends
Security between app and back end
days.lab_task: Design a BFF and a server-driven home screen for the app, support older app versions, cache responses for offline use and test layout changes without a release.
checks: Home screen changed without an app release
Old app version keeps working after a BFF change
objectives: Design back ends for iOS apps

days.topic: Troubleshooting Production iOS Issues: Crashes, Hangs and Terminations
days.lab_task: Work through four production issues: a launch crash, a hang on one screen, a watchdog termination and a regression after release, fix each and write one post-incident review.
days.deliverable: Incident notes and a post-incident review
checks: Crash rate drops after the fix
Review lists causes and follow-up actions

days.topic: Advanced Capstone: Multi-Module Banking App
days.lab_task: Design and build a multi-module banking app with team-owned packages, a design system, Swift 6 concurrency, App Attest, on-device AI, privacy compliance, phased releases and observability, then defend it to a review panel.
days.deliverable: Repository, release evidence and architecture defence
checks: Features built and released through separate packages
Security, privacy, performance and test reports meet targets
Review panel questions answered with evidence
objectives: Combine the advanced topics in one app
